caption: The drawing features a single object rendered in shades of gray and black on an off-white background. The object has a linear, elongated form and appears metallic, with a pointed tip extending horizontally to the right and a broader section on the left that transitions into a downward-curving, twisted segment resembling a spiral or helix. The overall shape of the object is angular with defined edges, and it is positioned centrally within a rectangular border drawn with a single thin line. The artist's signature, "F. Correa," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Foot Scraper
